deficiencies.description: The source uses the unclear pronoun “it” after mentioning both invasion and malignancy. The rewrite resolves this ambiguity by specifying that malignancy is what is being defined.

deficiencies.description: The word “because” adds an explicit causal link: it states that the cells fail to metastasise because they fail to survive at the secondary site. The source presents these as consecutive statements without explicitly stating that causal relationship.
